gist: Koyuki books the Seminar room through Yuuka for a Thursday 16:00 cipher practice session with Sensei.
transcript:
[{DAY} 00:00] What you remember of the last while

### chat:direct:user:sensei
# {DAY}
[you 07:22] Sensei! Good morning! Are you free this week to do the code-cracking practice session?
[user:sensei 07:30] Morning, Koyuki. Which days do you mean?
[you 07:31] Wednesday or Thursday after school! Either one!
[user:sensei 07:33] Thursday at 16:00 works. How long?
[you 07:34] An hour, tops. Where?
[user:sensei 07:35] The Seminar room, if Yuuka hasn't booked it for something else.
[you 07:36] [face=neutral] I'll ask her. If not, we use the second floor lab.
[user:sensei] Good. Let me know.
### chat:huddle:w9n4pe6jfy
# {DAY}
[you 10:30] *drops into the seat next to Momoi in the classroom*
[momoi-saiba 10:30] [face=happy] You're late! The teacher already took roll.
[you] I was at the vending machine. The strawberry milk was sold out, so I got the apple one.
[momoi-saiba] [face=surprised] Apple?! Who are you?
[you 10:32] Nihaha! A mystery!
[momoi-saiba] Did you finish the maths worksheet?
[you] Page one. I'll do page two at lunch.
[momoi-saiba 10:33] It's due at the end of the day.
[you] That's why it's lunch work.
### chat:huddle:z3c8vk2mqa
# {DAY}
[you 12:50] *knocks on the Seminar room door* Yuuka-senpai, is the room free on Thursday at 16:00?
[yuuka-hayase 12:50] Let me check. *opens the schedule* Thursday 16:00 to 17:00, yes, it's free.
[you] Can I book it? For a cipher practice with Sensei.
[yuuka-hayase] Name, purpose, and time on the sheet. *slides the booking sheet over*
[you 12:52] *fills it in* Done!
[yuuka-hayase] Don't leave snacks on the table.
[you] [face=mischievous] No snacks. Maybe a few.
[yuuka-hayase 12:53] None.
### chat:direct:user:sensei
# {DAY}
[you 13:10] Sensei, Seminar room is booked for Thursday 16:00!
[user:sensei 13:14] Got it. I'll be there.
[you 13:15] Bring your tablet, I want to try the new puzzle set.
[user:sensei] Okay.
[you 18:20] Also, Yuuka-senpai says the room has to be left tidy.
[user:sensei 18:24] Of course.
[you 18:25] Okay, see you Thursday!
